title: Bearing bore diameters (hypothesis test)
intro: The same sixteen bores: mean 25.004 mm, standard deviation 0.008 mm. Is the machine centered on 25.000 mm? The null hypothesis says the mean bore is 25.000 mm; the alternative says it is not. The test measures how far the sample mean is from 25.000 mm in standard errors. Module 8 teaches hypothesis tests fully.
